details: The visualization is essentially static: the force simulation is pre-computed via .stop()/.tick(300) before any rendering, there are no brush/zoom listeners, no cross-view dispatch, and no transitions that could be interrupted. Tooltip interactions use the unified Pointer Events API (pointerenter/pointermove/pointerleave), sidestepping the mouse-touch double-trigger problem entirely; pointermove only updates CSS position, not DOM structure or data joins.
